description: Recently filed Harris County (Houston, TX) civil cases, newest first — the "what is being filed in Houston right now" view. Optionally filter by case_type (e.g. "Motor Vehicle", "Debt", "Contract") or court number. Returns cause number, court, case type, decoded status, filing date, both parties and both attorneys.

case_type.description: Substring of the clerk's case type, e.g. "Motor Vehicle", "Debt".

court.description: District court number as published, e.g. "0055".

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: harris_civil_recent_filings
title: Harris Civil Recent Filings
